ideas.title: Uncovering Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the allegations of child care fraud in Minnesota, including the testimony from the House hearing and the warnings from former federal officials.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and track the allegations
questions: What is the extent of child care fraud in Minnesota?
How are officials responding to the allegations?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and highlight the need for increased oversight and regulation in the child care industry. I will track the allegations and look for connections to other entities.
